name: easy-event-study
what_it_holds: Small Python package (3 stars, last updated Oct 2025) billed as 'Financial Event Study made easy' -- a lighter-weight alternative to the LemaireJean-Baptiste eventstudy package for computing abnormal/cumulative-abnormal returns.
why_useful: Actively maintained (2025) alternative event-study implementation; worth a fallback if the older eventstudy package proves unmaintained/incompatible with current pandas.
themes: Event-study and factor packages; earnings-surprise datasets; post-earnings-drift replication; Ken French factor loaders
why_all: Actively maintained (2025) alternative event-study implementation; worth a fallback if the older eventstudy package proves unmaintained/incompatible with current pandas.

name: alphalens
what_it_holds: Quantopian's Python library for performance analysis of predictive (alpha) factors -- factor return/IC analysis, quantile spread returns, turnover. Archived (Quantopian shut down) but widely mirrored/forked; the maintained continuation is stefan-jansen/alphalens-reloaded.
why_useful: General factor-analysis tooling that could be applied to any ABNB-related signal (e.g., nights-nowcast residuals, ADR card) to test for factor-style predictive decay/IC the way a systematic desk would, complementing the harness's backtest scoring.
last_activity: archived (unmaintained); use stefan-jansen/alphalens-reloaded for current fork
themes: Event-study and factor packages; earnings-surprise datasets; post-earnings-drift replication; Ken French factor loaders
why_all: General factor-analysis tooling that could be applied to any ABNB-related signal (e.g., nights-nowcast residuals, ADR card) to test for factor-style predictive decay/IC the way a systematic desk would, complementing the harness's backtest scoring.

name: alphalens-reloaded
what_it_holds: Actively maintained fork/continuation of Quantopian's alphalens for predictive-factor performance analysis (IC, quantile returns, turnover), compatible with current pandas.
why_useful: Same use case as alphalens above but maintained -- preferred choice if the team ever wants formal factor-IC analysis on any ABNB signal.
duplicate_of_holding: Same functional role as quantopian/alphalens above.
themes: Event-study and factor packages; earnings-surprise datasets; post-earnings-drift replication; Ken French factor loaders
why_all: Same use case as alphalens above but maintained -- preferred choice if the team ever wants formal factor-IC analysis on any ABNB signal.

name: awesome-prediction-markets
what_it_holds: Curated list of prediction-market analytics tools, APIs, trading bots, dashboards, arbitrage tools and data feeds covering Polymarket, Kalshi, Hyperliquid, Limitless.
why_useful: Secondary discovery list; overlaps with Ong-pogs's list but CC0-licensed, useful cross-check for acquisition methods on event/earnings contracts.
themes: Prediction markets and betting data: Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold APIs and datasets on earnings and travel/regulation events
why_all: Secondary discovery list; overlaps with Ong-pogs's list but CC0-licensed, useful cross-check for acquisition methods on event/earnings contracts.

name: predmarket
what_it_holds: Python library 'predmarket' unifying Kalshi and Polymarket API access into one interface for market/price retrieval.
why_useful: Lower-friction acquisition method if we want to pull Kalshi's regulated CFTC event contracts (economic/regulatory, e.g. Fed decisions, government actions) alongside Polymarket without writing two separate clients.
themes: Prediction markets and betting data: Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold APIs and datasets on earnings and travel/regulation events
